content.text: How do you see the next two days shaking out? Will we get availability with the no. 1 pick on Wednesday night?
I got a bone to pick with you
Just a little bone, one of those 1,000 bones in your hands
Who asked that question? Who laid it up for him in the follow-up round? A big ol’ softball
Your story was good! McCoskey posted first. And used the quote.
I’m completely joking. But I did have another question for the follow-up round that we should talk about post-draft
I did not ask it. I don’t want to put Al in a certain position. But as the (only?) minority GM with a nearly all white baseball ops department in *Detroit* ... look at what Epstein said yesterday.
I think there’s an opportunity for Al to use his platform. I’ll give you all my thoughts when we talk, but consider this a story idea pitch
